title: A format a person made
description: summarising/v1 — the file `--format` names: the structure's name, its sections and the one that holds the actions, as minutes/v5's front matter says them. What a schema cannot say is on the contract's page: each id once, `actions` one of them.

structure.description: The format's name as the minutes write it; never one of the six structures minutes/v5 names.

sections.description: The sections, in their order: one to six.

about.description: What goes in the section, in the person's own words, any language.

actions.description: The id of the section that holds the actions; absent when the format has none.
